en:
## New Features

- Added a Gemini provider (Interactions API compatible) as a new protocol in the unified custom API system, with streaming, native function calling, thinking levels, and image input
- Composer drafts are now private per user and are no longer shared or leaked across accounts
- @handle mentions for named narrators are now case-insensitive with full CJK/Unicode support
- Editing a user message now supports image and text-file attachments, undo (Ctrl+Z), and paste
- The setup wizard now detects any provider that has usable models instead of a fixed list

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed duplicate message delivery when a Send addressed both a waiting reply and an ordinary target
- Task and tool timestamps now stay visible after completion and across resumed turns
- Fixed Gemini multi-step tool chains (thought signature) and schema-related 400 errors
- Fixed subagent tool snapshots losing their parent association
- Fixed the draft-length warning to format numbers using the active locale
- Fixed a scrollbar overlapping the switch/delete controls in provider settings

## Performance

- Background task lists no longer load each task's full output, avoiding main-thread stalls
- The pipeline cut command now rejects oversized field ranges that could freeze the backend

## Security

- Gemini API keys (x-goog-api-key) are now masked in request dumps
- Hardened upload path validation against traversal
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增 Gemini 提供商（兼容 Interactions API），作为统一自定义 API 系统的新协议，支持流式输出、原生函数调用、思考强度与图片输入
- 输入框草稿改为按用户私有存储，不再跨账户共享或泄漏
- 命名叙述者的 @handle 提及改为大小写不敏感，并完整支持中文/Unicode
- 编辑用户消息支持图片与文本文件附件、撤销（Ctrl+Z）与粘贴
- 设置向导改为自动识别任何有可用模型的提供商，不再依赖固定列表

## 修复

- 修复 Send 同时寻址等待回复与普通目标时导致的消息重复投递
- 任务与工具的时间戳在完成后及续跑回合中保持可见
- 修复 Gemini 多步工具链（思考签名）与 schema 相关的 400 错误
- 修复子代理工具快照丢失父级关联的问题
- 修复草稿超长提示的数字格式未按当前语言显示
- 修复提供商设置中滚动条遮挡开关/删除控件的问题

## 性能优化

- 后台任务列表不再加载每个任务的完整输出，避免主线程卡顿
- 管道 cut 命令拒绝可能冻结后端的超大字段范围

## 安全

- 请求转储中对 Gemini API 密钥（x-goog-api-key）进行脱敏
- 强化上传路径校验，防止路径穿越
